goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester walked to the Mission Board in the Lobby and tried to start a call with it five times, then tried SquadPad2 twice. Every interaction came back 'held, not triggered', so the round never left Lobby. No fires were fought, no one was rescued and no water was refilled.

bugs.title: Mission Board 'Pick a call' prompt never triggers, so the round cannot start
bugs.evidence: Steps 2, 3 and 5 interacted with Workspace.Map.Station.Lobby.MissionBoard at about 9.3 and 4.6 studs, inside the 16-stud range. Each returned 'held, not triggered', the round stayed in Lobby, and no call-selection UI appeared. This blocks the whole goal.

bugs.title: SquadPad 'Change call' prompt does not trigger
bugs.evidence: Steps 7 and 8 interacted with SquadPad2 at 6 studs (range 9) using key F with hold 0, then E with hold 1. Both returned 'held, not triggered' for 'Change call Pad 2', with no change in state or HUD. Lobby ProximityPrompts appear to be broken in general, not just the Mission Board.

bugs.title: Player position and 'near' list inconsistent with walk_to arrival
bugs.evidence: Step 1 reported arrival at the MissionBoard with pos=[-51,3.8,108], but the step 2 observation shows pos=[-32.4,3.5,165.4] with MissionBoard 9 studs away. The step 4 walk to (-39,3.5,168) reported arrival, yet the position still read [-32.4,3.5,165.4]. This may be a position or teleport desync, for example the character being moved after spawn, and it may be related to the prompts not firing. It could also be an observation lag.
